sources.title: FAQ about changes to GitHub's plans - GitHub Docs
sources.content:
If your organization account currently uses the GitHub Team for Open Source plan, you’ve been automatically moved to GitHub Free, which includes private repositories with unlimited collaborators, 2,000 Actions minutes for private repositories, and GitHub Community on Discussions. Actions minutes and Packages storage are still free for your public repositories.

## What is GitHub Community on Discussions? [...] Most small teams use fewer than 3,000 Actions minutes/month, but some teams might use more. If your team needs additional minutes for private repositories, you can increase your spending limit for GitHub Actions. Actions minutes and Packages storage are still free for your public repositories. For more information, see Setting up budgets to control spending on metered products.

## How do the seat limit changes affect me? [...] GitHub Team now has a reduced monthly price of $4 per user
 GitHub Team no longer has a required five-seat minimum
 GitHub Team includes 3,000 Actions minutes per month for private repositories

sources.title: GitHub's plans - GitHub Docs
sources.content:
GitHub Actions usage is free for standard GitHub-hosted runners in public repositories, and for self-hosted runners. See Choosing the runner for a job.

For private repositories, each GitHub account receives storage and a monthly included compute usage, depending on the account's plan. The cost of eligible runner usage draws from the included compute usage, which is also available for cloud sandbox compute and memory. Additional usage is billed to your account.

### GitHub Enterprise [...] With GitHub Free for organizations, you can work with unlimited collaborators on unlimited public repositories with a full feature set, or unlimited private repositories with a limited feature set.

In addition to the features available with GitHub Free for personal accounts, GitHub Free for organizations includes:

 GitHub Community Support
 Team access controls for managing groups
 $12 USD of included compute usage per month for eligible GitHub Actions and cloud sandbox usage [...] GitHub Support via email
